text: After consultation with the residents of the Old Sheppard Avenue area, the overwhelming consensus was that the neighbourhood would like to see a reduction of the posted speed limit to 40 km/h along Old Sheppard Avenue to enhance safety in the area. I respectfully request that this matter be added to the North York Community Council agenda, on Tuesday, January 16th 2018.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 km/h to 40 km/h on Old Sheppard Avenue.
